title: Tenma Saki — Dozing Off In Art Class〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Early morning
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thank goodness we managed to finish our assignments!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And it was so nice of the teacher to get here early.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm so glad♪
Now we can keep practicing without worrying about anything else!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe we both fell asleep during class like that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You actually get to do stuff during art. As busy as we were preparing for our solo show, I'm surprised we couldn't stay awake...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Let's be sure to never do that again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On top of getting scolded by the teacher, we have to spend extra time making up for our mistakes. I'd prefer to avoid all that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I think that was the first time I ever got scolded by a teacher!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's not true.
You definitely got scolded during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Remember when we tried to fling our shoes across the schoolyard?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You flung yours into the teachers' office and they got really mad at you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
R-Right. I kinda sorta vaguely recall...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Saki.
At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might not mind this kind of thing every so often.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
I really don't want to get scolded again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it really feels like we're enjoying school life, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand what you're trying to say, but does getting scolded by a teacher count as us enjoying school life?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It so does! Because it's like one of the cornerstones of being a student!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sure. That's bound to happen to anyone at school... But I'd sort of rather enjoy school in a more positive way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In a more positive way?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, such as...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about volunteering for something together...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, volunteering!
We could collect donations or pick up litter somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Remember how we did that a few times during elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Going somewhere with your classmates while class is in session is something you can only experience when you're in school, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Stuff like that's always really fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also...!
Getting the blackboard to be totally spotless! That's something you can only do at school!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never thought about that, but I agree about it being very school-specific.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
And I always love using the machine that shakes chalk off the erasers♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I hear some voices in the distance...
That must be everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, that's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, wanna say good morning to everyone as they enter our classroom?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A hearty greeting to start off the day!
That's also really school-like, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Those are the kinds of things I'd never think of doing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, Saki, let's say good morning to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning!
